<p style="text-align:center;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;" id="DEFINITIONS">DEFINITIONS</p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:4%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Unless the context otherwise indicates, references to &#8220;us,&#8221; &#8220;we,&#8221; &#8220;our,&#8221; &#8220;ours,&#8221; &#8220;Devon&#8221; and the &#8220;Company&#8221; refer to Devon Energy Corporation and its consolidated subsidiaries. <span style="color:#000000;">All monetary values, other than per unit and per share amounts, are stated in millions of U.S. dollars unless otherwise specified. </span>In addition, the following are other abbreviations and definitions of certain terms used within this Quarterly Report on Form 10-Q:</p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#8220;ASC&#8221; means Accounting Standards Codification.</p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#8220;ASR&#8221; means an accelerated share-repurchase transaction with a financial institution to repurchase Devon&#8217;s common stock.</p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#8220;ASU&#8221; means Accounting Standards Update.</p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#8220;Bbl&#8221; or &#8220;Bbls&#8221; means barrel or barrels.</p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:4%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#8220;Boe&#8221; means barrel of oil equivalent. Gas proved reserves and production are converted to Boe, at the pressure and temperature base standard of each respective state in which the gas is produced, at the rate of six Mcf of gas per Bbl of oil, based upon the approximate relative energy content of gas and oil. Bitumen and NGL proved reserves and production are converted to Boe on a one-to-one basis with oil.</p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#8220;Btu&#8221; means British thermal units, a measure of heating value.</p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:4%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#8220;Canada&#8221; means the division of Devon encompassing oil and gas properties located in Canada. All dollar amounts associated with Canada are in U.S. dollars, unless stated otherwise.</p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#8220;Canadian Plan&#8221; means Devon Canada Corporation Incentive Savings Plan.</p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#8220;DD&#38;A&#8221; means depreciation, depletion and amortization expenses.</p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#8220;Devon Plan&#8221; means Devon Energy Corporation Incentive Savings Plan.</p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#8220;E&#38;P&#8221; means exploration and production activities.</p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#8220;EnLink&#8221; means EnLink Midstream Partners, LP, a master limited partnership.</p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#8220;FASB&#8221; means Financial Accounting Standards Board.</p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#8220;G&#38;A&#8221; means general and administrative expenses.</p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:0.54%;text-indent:3.46%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#8220;GAAP&#8221; means U.S. generally accepted accounting principles.</p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:4%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#8220;General Partner&#8221; means EnLink Midstream, LLC, the indirect general partner of EnLink, and, unless the context otherwise indicates, EnLink Midstream Manager, LLC, the managing member of EnLink Midstream, LLC.</p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#8220;Inside FERC&#8221; refers to the publication <span style="font-style:italic;">Inside FERC&#8217;s Gas Market Report</span>.</p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#8220;LOE&#8221; means lease operating expenses.</p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#8220;MBbls&#8221; means thousand barrels.</p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#8220;MBoe&#8221; means thousand Boe.</p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#8220;Mcf&#8221; means thousand cubic feet.</p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#8220;MMBoe&#8221; means million Boe.</p>

<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><span style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#8220;MMBtu&#8221; means million Btu.</span></p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#8220;MMcf&#8221; means million cubic feet.</p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#8220;N/M&#8221; means not meaningful.</p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#8220;NGL&#8221; or &#8220;NGLs&#8221; means natural gas liquids.</p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#8220;NYMEX&#8221; means New York Mercantile Exchange.</p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#8220;OPIS&#8221; means Oil Price Information Service.</p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#8220;SEC&#8221; means United States Securities and Exchange Commission.</p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#8220;Senior Credit Facility&#8221; means Devon&#8217;s syndicated unsecured revolving line of credit, effective as of October 5, 2018. </p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#8220;TSR&#8221; means total shareholder return.</p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#8220;Upstream operations&#8221; means upstream revenues minus production expenses.</p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#8220;U.S.&#8221; means United States of America.</p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#8220;WTI&#8221; means West Texas Intermediate.</p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#8220;/Bbl&#8221; means per barrel.</p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#8220;/d&#8221; means per day.</p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#8220;/MMBtu&#8221; means per MMBtu.</p>

<p style="text-align:center;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;color:#auto;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><span style="text-decoration:none;">NOTES TO CONSOLIDATED FINANCIAL STATEMENTS</span></p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;color:#auto;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><span style="text-decoration:none;">(Unaudited)</span><span style="text-decoration:underline;font-weight:normal;color:#000000;"> </span></p><ix:nonNumeric id="F_000278" name="us-gaap:OrganizationConsolidationBasisOfPresentationBusinessDescriptionAndAccountingPoliciesTextBlock" contextRef="C_0001090012_20190101_20190331" escape="true">

<td valign="top" style="width:4.54%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><span style="font-weight:bold;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">1.</span></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;" id="NOTES_TO_CONSOLIDATED_FINANCIAL_STATEMEN">Summary of Significant Accounting Policies</p></td></tr></table></div>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">The accompanying unaudited interim financial statements and notes of Devon have been prepared pursuant to the rules and regulations of the SEC. Pursuant to such rules and regulations, certain disclosures normally included in financial statements prepared in accordance with U.S. GAAP have been omitted. The accompanying unaudited interim financial statements and notes should be read in conjunction with the financial statements and notes included in Devon&#8217;s <a href="http://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1090012/000156459019003382/dvn-10k_20181231.htm"><span style="text-decoration:underline;">2018 Annual Report on Form 10-K</span>.</a></p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">The accompanying unaudited interim financial statements in this report reflect all adjustments that are, in the opinion of management, necessary for a fair statement of Devon&#8217;s results of operations and cash flows for the three-month periods ended March 31, 2019 and 2018 and Devon&#8217;s financial position as of March 31, 2019. As further discussed in <a href="#N19_DISCONTINUED_OPERATIONS_ASSETS_HELD_"><span style="text-decoration:underline;">Note 19</span>, </a>Devon sold its interests in EnLink and the General Partner on July 18, 2018. Activity relating to EnLink and the General Partner are classified as discontinued operations within Devon&#8217;s consolidated comprehensive statements of earnings and consolidated statements of cash flows. </p><ix:nonNumeric id="F_000300" name="us-gaap:NewAccountingPronouncementsPolicyPolicyTextBlock" contextRef="C_0001090012_20190101_20190331" escape="true">
<p style="margin-top:18pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-style:italic;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Recently Adopted Accounting Standards</p>
<p style="margin-top:2pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;">&#160;</p>
<p style="margin-top:2pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">In January 2019, Devon adopted ASU 2016-02, <span style="font-style:italic;">Leases (Topic 842)</span>, using the modified retrospective method. See <a href="#N15_LEASES"><span style="text-decoration:underline;">Note 15</span></a><span style="text-decoration:none;"> </span>for further discussion regarding Devon&#8217;s adoption of the leases standard. </p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:12pt;text-indent:4%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">The SEC released Final Rule No. 33 -10532, <span style="font-style:italic;">Disclosure Update and Simplification</span>, which amends various SEC disclosure requirements determined to be redundant, duplicative, overlapping, outdated or superseded as part of the SEC&#8217;s ongoing disclosure effectiveness initiative. The rule was effective November 5, 2018. The rule amended numerous SEC rules, items and forms covering a diverse group of topics. Devon has implemented these required changes which generally reduced or eliminated disclosures. Devon adopted the requirement of presenting current and comparative quarterly stockholders&#8217; equity roll forwards in the first quarter of 2019.</p>
<p style="margin-top:18pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-style:italic;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Issued Accounting Standards Not Yet Adopted</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:2pt;text-indent:5.94%;font-size:10pt;">&#160;</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:2pt;text-indent:4%;color:#000000;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">The FASB issued ASU 2018-13, <span style="font-style:italic;">Fair Value Measurement (Topic 820): Changes to the Disclosure Requirements for Fair Value Measurement</span>. This ASU will eliminate, add and modify certain disclosure requirements for fair value measurement. The ASU is effective for annual and interim periods beginning January 1, 2020, with early adoption permitted for either the entire standard or only the provisions that eliminate or modify requirements. The ASU requires the additional disclosure requirements to be adopted using a retrospective approach. Devon is currently evaluating the provisions of this ASU and assessing the impact it may have on its disclosures in the notes to the consolidated financial statements. </p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:2pt;text-indent:5.94%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#160;</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:2pt;text-indent:4%;color:#000000;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">The FASB issued ASU 2018-15, <span style="font-style:italic;">Intangibles, Goodwill and Other Internal-Use Software (Subtopic 350-40): Customer&#8217;s Accounting for Implementation Costs Incurred in a Cloud Computing Arrangement that is a Service Contract</span>. This ASU will require a customer in a cloud computing arrangement (i.e., hosting arrangement) that is a service contract to follow the internal-use software guidance in ASC 350-40 to determine which implementation costs to capitalize as assets or expense as incurred. Capitalized implementation costs related to a hosting arrangement that is a service contract will be amortized over the term of the hosting arrangement, beginning when the module or component of the hosting arrangement is ready for its intended use. This ASU is effective for annual and interim periods beginning January 1, 2020, with early adoption permitted. Entities have the option to adopt the ASU using either a retrospective approach or a prospective approach applied to all implementation costs incurred after the date of the adoption. Devon is currently evaluating the provisions of this ASU and assessing the impact it may have on its consolidated financial statements.<span style="font-size:12pt;color:#000000;"> </span></p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:6%;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;">&#160;</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:2pt;text-indent:4%;color:#000000;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">The SEC released Final Rule Release No. 33-10618<span style="font-style:italic;">, FAST Act Modernization and Simplification of Regulation S-K</span>, which amends Regulation S-K to modernize and simplify certain disclosure requirements in a manner that reduces costs and burdens on registrants while continuing to provide all material information to investors. The rule is effective May 2, 2019. The rule amends numerous SEC rules, items and forms covering a diverse group of topics. As the changes are generally expected to reduce or eliminate disclosures,&#160;Devon is currently evaluating and assessing the impact it may have on its disclosures.</p></ix:nonNumeric>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;">&#160;</p></ix:nonNumeric>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-top:12pt;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">10</p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;">&#160;</p>
<hr style="page-break-after:always" />
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a href="#TABLE_OF_CONTENTS"><span style="text-decoration:underline;">Table of Contents</span></a></p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;color:#auto;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><span style="text-decoration:none;">DEVON ENERGY CORPORATION AND SUBSIDIARIES</span></p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;color:#auto;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><span style="text-decoration:none;">NOTES TO CONSOLIDATED FINANCIAL STATEMENTS &#8211; (Continued)</span></p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;color:#auto;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><span style="text-decoration:none;">(Unaudited)</span><span style="text-decoration:underline;font-weight:normal;color:#000000;"> </span></p><ix:nonNumeric id="F_000279" name="us-gaap:MergersAcquisitionsAndDispositionsDisclosuresTextBlock" contextRef="C_0001090012_20190101_20190331" escape="true">
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;" id="N2_DIVESTITURES">2.<span style="margin-left:21pt;">Dive</span>stitures</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:12pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-style:italic;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">2019 Asset Divestitures</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:12pt;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;text-indent:3.89%;">In the first quarter of 2019, Devon received proceeds of approximately $<ix:nonFraction unitRef="U_iso4217USD" id="F_000333" name="us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleOfOilAndGasPropertyAndEquipment" contextRef="C_0001090012_srtStatementGeographicalAxis_dvnPermianBasinMember_us-gaapPropertyPlantAndEquipmentByTypeAxis_dvnNonCoreAssetsMember_20190101_20190331" decimals="-6" scale="6">300</ix:nonFraction>&#160;million and recognized a net gain on asset dispositions of approximately $<ix:nonFraction unitRef="U_iso4217USD" id="F_000334" name="us-gaap:GainLossOnDispositionOfAssets1" contextRef="C_0001090012_srtStatementGeographicalAxis_dvnPermianBasinMember_us-gaapPropertyPlantAndEquipmentByTypeAxis_dvnNonCoreAssetsMember_20190101_20190331" decimals="-6" scale="6">44</ix:nonFraction>&#160;million, primarily from sales of non-core assets in the Permian Basin. In aggregate, the total estimated proved reserves associated with these divested assets were approximately&#160;<ix:nonFraction unitRef="U_utrMMBoe" id="F_000335" name="srt:ProvedDevelopedAndUndevelopedReservesSaleOfMineralInPlaceEnergy" contextRef="C_0001090012_srtStatementGeographicalAxis_dvnPermianBasinMember_us-gaapPropertyPlantAndEquipmentByTypeAxis_dvnNonCoreAssetsMember_20190101_20190331" decimals="0">25</ix:nonFraction>&#160;MMBoe, or less than&#160;<ix:nonFraction unitRef="U_xbrlipure" id="F_000336" name="dvn:USProvedDevelopedReservesSoldBOEPercent" contextRef="C_0001090012_srtRangeAxis_srtMaximumMember_srtStatementGeographicalAxis_dvnPermianBasinMember_us-gaapPropertyPlantAndEquipmentByTypeAxis_dvnNonCoreAssetsMember_20190101_20190331" decimals="2" scale="-2">2</ix:nonFraction>% of total U.S. proved reserves. As of December 31, 2018, assets and liabilities associated with these divested assets were classified as held for sale in the accompanying consolidated balance sheet.</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:3.89%;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;">&#160;</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:4%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">In February 2019, Devon announced its intent to separate its Canadian business and Barnett Shale assets from the Company, based on authorizations provided by its Board of Directors. Devon is evaluating multiple methods of separation for these assets, including potential sales or spin-offs. As of March 31, 2019, Devon does not currently have any indications that it would recognize an impairment upon separating its Canadian business or its Barnett Shale assets. </p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:4%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;">&#160;</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:4%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Devon anticipates reporting all financial information for its Canadian business and Barnett Shale assets as discontinued operations in 2019 when all the requisite criteria are met for such financial statement presentation.</p></ix:nonNumeric><ix:nonNumeric id="F_000280" name="us-gaap:DerivativeInstrumentsAndHedgingActivitiesDisclosureTextBlock" contextRef="C_0001090012_20190101_20190331" escape="true" continuedAt="F_000280_dcnt_f724c249-21a7-46ed-8a74-4697f5f6b8c1">
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;">&#160;</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;" id="N3_DERIVATIVE_FINANCIAL_INSTRUMENTS">3.<span style="margin-left:21pt;">Derivative Fin</span>ancial Instruments</p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-style:italic;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Objectives and Strategies</p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Devon enters into derivative financial instruments with respect to a portion of its oil, gas and NGL production to hedge future prices received. Additionally, Devon periodically enters into derivative financial instruments with respect to a portion of its oil, gas and NGL marketing activities. These commodity derivative financial instruments include financial price swaps, basis swaps and costless price collars. Devon periodically enters into interest rate swaps to manage its exposure to interest rate volatility and foreign exchange forward contracts to manage its exposure to fluctuations in the U.S. and Canadian dollar exchange rates. As of March 31, 2019, Devon did not have any open interest rate swap or foreign exchange contracts.</p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Devon does not intend to hold or issue derivative financial instruments for speculative trading purposes and has elected not to designate any of its derivative instruments for hedge accounting treatment.</p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-style:italic;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Counterparty Credit Risk</p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">By using derivative financial instruments, Devon is exposed to credit risk. Credit risk is the failure of the counterparty to perform under the terms of the derivative contract. To mitigate this risk, the hedging instruments are placed with a number of counterparties whom Devon believes are acceptable credit risks. It is Devon&#8217;s policy to enter into derivative contracts only with investment-grade rated counterparties deemed by management to be competent and competitive market makers. Additionally, Devon&#8217;s derivative contracts generally contain provisions that provide for collateral payments if Devon&#8217;s or its counterparty&#8217;s credit rating falls below certain credit rating levels.</p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-style:italic;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Commodity Derivatives</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:6pt;margin-top:12pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">As of March 31, 2019, Devon had the following open oil derivative positions. The first two tables present Devon&#8217;s oil derivatives that settle against the average of the prompt month NYMEX WTI futures price. The third table presents Devon&#8217;s oil derivatives that settle against the respective indices noted within the table.</p><ix:nonNumeric id="F_000302" name="us-gaap:ScheduleOfDerivativeInstrumentsTextBlock" contextRef="C_0001090012_us-gaapTradingActivityByTypeAxis_dvnOpenOilDerivativePositionsMember_20190101_20190331" escape="true" continuedAt="F_000302_dcnt_cb69d8c6-2d87-4c5b-8152-ad9237f55d4c">

<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;">&#160;</p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;" id="N5_RESTRUCTURING_TRANSACTION_COSTS">5.<span style="margin-left:21pt;">Restructuring and</span> Transaction Costs</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:12pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-style:italic;color:#000000;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Workforce Reductions</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:12pt;text-indent:4%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">During the first quarter of 2019, Devon announced workforce reductions and other initiatives designed to enhance its operational focus and cost structure in conjunction with the portfolio transformation announcement further discussed in <a href="#N2_DIVESTITURES"><span style="text-decoration:underline;">Note 2.</span></a> As a result, Devon recognized $<ix:nonFraction unitRef="U_iso4217USD" id="F_000457" name="us-gaap:RestructuringCharges" contextRef="C_0001090012_us-gaapRestructuringPlanAxis_dvnReductionOfWorkforceMember_20190101_20190331" decimals="-6" scale="6">54</ix:nonFraction> million of restructuring expenses during the first three months of 2019. Of these expenses, $<ix:nonFraction unitRef="U_iso4217USD" id="F_000458" name="us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardAcceleratedCompensationCost" contextRef="C_0001090012_us-gaapRestructuringPlanAxis_dvnReductionOfWorkforceMember_20190101_20190331" decimals="-6" scale="6">22</ix:nonFraction> million resulted from accelerated vesting of share-based grants, which are noncash charges. Devon anticipates recognizing additional restructuring charges in 2019 primarily when the separation of the Canadian and Barnett Shale assets are completed.</p><ix:nonNumeric id="F_000310" name="us-gaap:ScheduleOfRestructuringReserveByTypeOfCostTextBlock" contextRef="C_0001090012_20190101_20190331" escape="true">
<p style="margin-bottom:12pt;margin-top:12pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">The following table summarizes Devon&#8217;s restructuring liabilities.</p>

<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:4%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">The U.S. dollar is the functional currency for Devon&#8217;s consolidated operations except its Canadian subsidiaries, which use the Canadian dollar as the functional currency. The amounts in the table above include both unrealized and realized foreign exchange impacts of foreign currency denominated monetary assets and liabilities, including intercompany loans between subsidiaries with different functional currencies.&#160;Unrealized gains and losses arise from the remeasurement of these foreign currency denominated monetary assets and liabilities and intercompany loans.&#160;Realized gains and losses arise when there are settlements of these foreign currency denominated monetary assets and liabilities and intercompany loans.</p></ix:nonNumeric>

<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;">&#160;</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Devon estimates its annual effective income tax rate to record its quarterly provision for income taxes in the various jurisdictions in which it operates.&#160;Statutory tax rate changes and other significant or unusual items are recognized as discrete items in the quarter in which they occur. </p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">In the table above, the &#8220;other&#8221; effect is primarily composed of permanent differences for which dollar amounts do not increase or decrease in relation to the change in pre-tax earnings. Generally, such items have an insignificant impact on Devon&#8217;s effective income tax rate. However, these items had a more noticeable impact to the rate in the first three months of 2018 due to the low relative net loss during the period.</p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">In the first quarter of 2019, the deferred tax asset representing Devon&#8217;s U.S. state net operating loss subject to a valuation allowance decreased by $<ix:nonFraction unitRef="U_iso4217USD" id="F_000501" name="us-gaap:ValuationAllowanceDeferredTaxAssetChangeInAmount" contextRef="C_0001090012_20190101_20190331" decimals="-6" sign="-" scale="6">13</ix:nonFraction> million. The corresponding decrease in the valuation allowance against the state net operating loss resulted in a deferred tax benefit, which is included within state income taxes in the table above.</p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">As of the first quarter of 2018, Devon&#8217;s U.S. segment maintained a <ix:nonFraction unitRef="U_xbrlipure" id="F_000502" name="dvn:PercentageOfDeferredTaxAssetsRecordedAsValuationAllowance" contextRef="C_0001090012_20180101_20180331" decimals="2" scale="-2">100</ix:nonFraction>% valuation allowance against its U.S. deferred tax assets resulting from prior year cumulative financial losses, oil and gas impairments, and significant net operating losses for U.S. federal and state income tax. However, upon closing the EnLink divestiture in the third quarter of 2018, Devon reassessed its position and determined that its U.S. segment was no longer in a full valuation allowance position, maintaining only valuation allowances against certain deferred tax assets, including certain tax credits and state net operating losses. Devon&#8217;s Canadian segment maintains a valuation allowance against certain capital loss carryforwards. </p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">During the first quarter of 2019, Devon announced its intent to separate all Canadian assets. As a result, Devon&#8217;s foreign earnings were no longer considered indefinitely reinvested as of March 31, 2019. However, the deferred tax asset of its Canadian investment will not be recorded until the form of the separation is certain. </p>

<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-style:italic;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Credit Lines</p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Devon has a $<ix:nonFraction unitRef="U_iso4217USD" id="F_000656" name="us-gaap:LineOfCreditFacilityMaximumBorrowingCapacity" contextRef="C_0001090012_us-gaapCreditFacilityAxis_us-gaapLineOfCreditMember_20190331" decimals="-8" scale="9">3.0</ix:nonFraction> billion Senior Credit Facility. As of March 31, 2019, Devon had <ix:nonFraction unitRef="U_iso4217USD" id="F_000657" name="us-gaap:LineOfCredit" contextRef="C_0001090012_us-gaapCreditFacilityAxis_us-gaapLineOfCreditMember_20190331" decimals="0" format="ixt-sec:numwordsen">no</ix:nonFraction> outstanding borrowings under the Senior Credit Facility and had issued $<ix:nonFraction unitRef="U_iso4217USD" id="F_000659" name="us-gaap:LettersOfCreditOutstandingAmount" contextRef="C_0001090012_us-gaapCreditFacilityAxis_us-gaapLineOfCreditMember_20190331" decimals="-6" scale="6">52</ix:nonFraction> million in outstanding letters of credit under this facility. The Senior Credit Facility contains only one material financial covenant. This covenant requires Devon&#8217;s ratio of total funded debt to total capitalization, as defined in the credit agreement, to be no greater than <ix:nonFraction unitRef="U_xbrlipure" id="F_000660" name="us-gaap:RatioOfIndebtednessToNetCapital1" contextRef="C_0001090012_srtRangeAxis_srtMaximumMember_us-gaapCreditFacilityAxis_us-gaapLineOfCreditMember_20190331" decimals="2" scale="-2">65</ix:nonFraction>%. Under the terms of the credit agreement, total capitalization is adjusted to add back noncash financial write-downs such as impairments. <p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;;font-size:9pt;">&#160;</p></ix:continuation><ix:nonNumeric id="F_000292" name="us-gaap:LeasesOfLesseeDisclosureTextBlock" contextRef="C_0001090012_20190101_20190331" escape="true" continuedAt="F_000292_dcnt_ddbf2b77-fd0e-4606-9b44-691994f96a79">
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;">&#160;</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;" id="N15_LEASES">15.<span style="margin-left:22pt;">Le</span>ases</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:6pt;">&#160;</p>
<p style="margin-top:2pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Devon adopted ASU No. 2016-02, <span style="font-style:italic;">Leases (Topic 842)</span>, as of January 1, 2019, using the modified retrospective transition approach. ASC 842 supersedes the previous lease accounting requirements in ASC 840 and requires lessees to recognize leases on-balance sheet and disclose key information about leasing arrangements. ASC 842 establishes a right-of-use model that requires a lessee to recognize a right-of-use asset and lease liability on the balance sheet for all leases with a term longer than 12 months. At adoption, using the modified retrospective transition approach, Devon recorded right-of-use lease assets of $<ix:nonFraction unitRef="U_iso4217USD" id="F_000681" name="dvn:RightOfUseAssetsNoncurrent" contextRef="C_0001090012_us-gaapAdjustmentsForNewAccountingPronouncementsAxis_us-gaapAccountingStandardsUpdate201602Member_20190101" decimals="-6" scale="6">394</ix:nonFraction> million and lease liabilities of $<ix:nonFraction unitRef="U_iso4217USD" id="F_000682" name="dvn:LeaseLiabilities" contextRef="C_0001090012_us-gaapAdjustmentsForNewAccountingPronouncementsAxis_us-gaapAccountingStandardsUpdate201602Member_20190101" decimals="-6" scale="6">380</ix:nonFraction> million. Additionally, Devon recorded a $<ix:nonFraction unitRef="U_iso4217USD" id="F_000683" name="us-gaap:CumulativeEffectOnRetainedEarningsBeforeTax1" contextRef="C_0001090012_us-gaapAdjustmentsForNewAccountingPronouncementsAxis_us-gaapAccountingStandardsUpdate201602Member_20190101_20190101" decimals="-6" sign="-" scale="6">24</ix:nonFraction> million before tax, $<ix:nonFraction unitRef="U_iso4217USD" id="F_000684" name="us-gaap:CumulativeEffectOnRetainedEarningsNetOfTax1" contextRef="C_0001090012_us-gaapAdjustmentsForNewAccountingPronouncementsAxis_us-gaapAccountingStandardsUpdate201602Member_20190101_20190101" decimals="-6" sign="-" scale="6">19</ix:nonFraction> million net of tax, cumulative-effect adjustment to reduce retained earnings. Comparative periods have been presented in accordance with ASC Topic 840 and do not include any retrospective adjustments to reflect the adoption of Topic 842. Excluding land easements and rights-of-way, all leases that existed at January 1, 2019 or were entered into or modified thereafter, are accounted for under Topic 842. Devon elected the practical expedient provided in the standard that allows the new guidance to be applied prospectively to all new or modified land easements and rights-of-way. Devon also elected a policy not to recognize right-of-use assets and lease liabilities related to short-term leases with terms of 12 months or less. Additionally, Devon elected to account for lease components separately from the nonlease components.</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;">&#160;</p>
<p style="margin-top:2pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Devon made certain significant assumptions and judgments in determining its right-of-use asset and lease liability balances. First is the determination of whether a contract contains a lease. Devon considered the presence of an identified asset that is physically distinct, and for which the supplier does not have substantive substitution rights and whether Devon has the right to control the underlying asset. Second, Devon assessed lease terms and considered whether Devon is reasonably certain to extend leases or exercise purchase options. Certain of Devon&#8217;s leases include one or more options to renew, with renewal terms that can extend the lease term for additional years. Certain leases also include options to purchase the leased property. For options to renew or purchase that Devon is reasonably certain to exercise, these costs are recognized as part of the right-of-use assets and lease liabilities. Third, significant judgments have been made in determining discount rates. Devon estimates discount rates using market rates that approximate collateralized borrowings over the remaining term of Devon&#8217;s lease payments. </p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;">&#160;</p>
<p style="margin-top:2pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Devon&#8217;s right-of-use operating lease assets are for certain leases related to real estate, drilling rigs and other equipment related to the exploration, development and production of oil and gas. Devon&#8217;s right-of-use financing lease assets are related to real estate. Certain of Devon&#8217;s lease agreements include variable payments based on usage or rental payments adjusted periodically for inflation. Devon&#8217;s lease agreements do not contain any material residual value guarantees or restrictive covenants.&#160;&#160;</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:12pt;">&#160;</p>

In February 2019, Devon announced a <ix:nonFraction unitRef="U_xbrlipure" id="F_000816" name="dvn:PercentageIncreaseInQuarterlyDividend" contextRef="C_0001090012_20190228" decimals="3" scale="-2">12.5</ix:nonFraction>% increase to its quarterly dividend, to $<ix:nonFraction unitRef="U_iso4217USD_xbrlishares" id="F_000817" name="us-gaap:CommonStockDividendsPerShareDeclared" contextRef="C_0001090012_20190201_20190228" decimals="2">0.09</ix:nonFraction> per share, beginning in the second quarter of 2019. <p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;" id="N19_DISCONTINUED_OPERATIONS_ASSETS_HELD_">Discontinued Operations and Assets Held For Sale</p></td></tr></table></div>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:4.54%;text-indent:-4.54%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;">&#160;</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">On June 6, 2018, Devon announced that it had entered into an agreement to sell its aggregate ownership interests in EnLink and the General Partner for $<ix:nonFraction unitRef="U_iso4217USD" id="F_000820" name="us-gaap:ProceedsFromDivestitureOfBusinesses" contextRef="C_0001090012_deiLegalEntityAxis_dvnEnLinkAndGeneralPartnerMember_20180701_20180930" decimals="-6" scale="9">3.125</ix:nonFraction> billion. Upon entering into the agreement to sell its ownership interest in June 2018, Devon concluded that the transaction was a strategic shift and met the requirements of assets held for sale and discontinued operations. As a result, Devon classified the results of operations and cash flows related to EnLink and the General Partner as discontinued operations on its consolidated financial statements. </p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;">&#160;</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">On <ix:nonNumeric id="F_000821" name="us-gaap:DisposalDate1" contextRef="C_0001090012_deiLegalEntityAxis_dvnEnLinkAndGeneralPartnerMember_20190101_20190331" format="ixt:datemonthdayyearen">July 18, 2018</ix:nonNumeric>, Devon completed the sale of its aggregate ownership interests in EnLink and the General Partner for $<ix:nonFraction unitRef="U_iso4217USD" id="F_000822" name="us-gaap:ProceedsFromDivestitureOfBusinesses" contextRef="C_0001090012_deiLegalEntityAxis_dvnEnLinkAndGeneralPartnerMember_20180701_20180930" decimals="-6" scale="9">3.125</ix:nonFraction> billion and recognized a gain of approximately $<ix:nonFraction unitRef="U_iso4217USD" id="F_000823" name="us-gaap:DiscontinuedOperationGainLossFromDisposalOfDiscontinuedOperationBeforeIncomeTax" contextRef="C_0001090012_deiLegalEntityAxis_dvnEnLinkAndGeneralPartnerMember_20180701_20180930" decimals="-8" scale="9">2.6</ix:nonFraction> billion ($<ix:nonFraction unitRef="U_iso4217USD" id="F_000824" name="us-gaap:DiscontinuedOperationGainLossOnDisposalOfDiscontinuedOperationNetOfTax" contextRef="C_0001090012_deiLegalEntityAxis_dvnEnLinkAndGeneralPartnerMember_20180701_20180930" decimals="-8" scale="9">2.2</ix:nonFraction> billion after-tax). Current (cash) income tax associated with the transaction was approximately $<ix:nonFraction unitRef="U_iso4217USD" id="F_000825" name="dvn:CashIncomeTaxes" contextRef="C_0001090012_deiLegalEntityAxis_dvnEnLinkAndGeneralPartnerMember_20180701_20180930" decimals="-6" scale="6">12</ix:nonFraction> million. The vast majority of the tax effect relates to deferred tax expense offset by the valuation allowance adjustment. </p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;">&#160;</p>

Although the agreements were extended to 2029, the minimum volume commitments for the Bridgeport and Cana plants expired at the end of 2018. Devon has minimum volume commitments for gathering and processing of <ix:nonFraction unitRef="U_utrMMcf" id="F_000828" name="dvn:MinimumGatheringVolumeCommitmentPerDay" contextRef="C_0001090012_deiLegalEntityAxis_dvnEnLinkAndGeneralPartnerMember_srtRangeAxis_srtMinimumMember_us-gaapSupplyCommitmentAxis_dvnChisholmGatheringAndProcessingContractMember_20190101_20190331" decimals="INF"><ix:nonFraction unitRef="U_utrMMcf" id="F_000830" name="dvn:MinimumProcessingVolumeCommitmentPerDay" contextRef="C_0001090012_deiLegalEntityAxis_dvnEnLinkAndGeneralPartnerMember_srtRangeAxis_srtMinimumMember_us-gaapSupplyCommitmentAxis_dvnChisholmGatheringAndProcessingContractMember_20190101_20190331" decimals="INF">77</ix:nonFraction></ix:nonFraction>-<ix:nonFraction unitRef="U_utrMMcf" id="F_000829" name="dvn:MinimumGatheringVolumeCommitmentPerDay" contextRef="C_0001090012_deiLegalEntityAxis_dvnEnLinkAndGeneralPartnerMember_srtRangeAxis_srtMaximumMember_us-gaapSupplyCommitmentAxis_dvnChisholmGatheringAndProcessingContractMember_20190101_20190331" decimals="INF"><ix:nonFraction unitRef="U_utrMMcf" id="F_000831" name="dvn:MinimumProcessingVolumeCommitmentPerDay" contextRef="C_0001090012_deiLegalEntityAxis_dvnEnLinkAndGeneralPartnerMember_srtRangeAxis_srtMaximumMember_us-gaapSupplyCommitmentAxis_dvnChisholmGatheringAndProcessingContractMember_20190101_20190331" decimals="INF">128</ix:nonFraction></ix:nonFraction> MMcf/d with EnLink at the Chisholm plant through <ix:nonNumeric id="F_000827" name="dvn:GatheringAndProcessingMinimumVolumeCommitmentsPeriodEnd" contextRef="C_0001090012_deiLegalEntityAxis_dvnEnLinkAndGeneralPartnerMember_us-gaapSupplyCommitmentAxis_dvnChisholmGatheringAndProcessingContractMember_20190101_20190331">early 2021</ix:nonNumeric>. </p>

<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;" id="COMMITMENTS">Commitments and Contingencies</p></td></tr></table></div><ix:nonNumeric id="F_000301" name="us-gaap:CommitmentsAndContingenciesPolicyTextBlock" contextRef="C_0001090012_20190101_20190331" escape="true">
<p style="margin-top:6pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;color:#000000;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Devon is party to various legal actions arising in the normal course of business. Matters that are probable of unfavorable outcome to Devon and which can be reasonably estimated are accrued. Such accruals are based on information known about the matters, Devon&#8217;s estimates of the outcomes of such matters and its experience in contesting, litigating and settling similar matters. None of the actions are believed by management to likely involve future amounts that would be material to Devon&#8217;s financial position or results of operations after consideration of recorded accruals. Actual amounts could differ materially from management&#8217;s estimates<span style="color:#000000;">.</span></p></ix:nonNumeric>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-style:italic;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Royalty Matters</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:6pt;text-indent:4.54%;color:#000000;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Numerous oil and natural gas producers and related parties, including Devon, have been named in various lawsuits alleging royalty underpayments. Devon is currently named as a defendant in a number of such lawsuits, including some lawsuits in which the plaintiffs seek to certify classes of similarly situated plaintiffs. Among the allegations typically asserted in these suits are claims that Devon used below-market prices, made improper deductions, used improper measurement techniques and entered into gas purchase and processing arrangements with affiliates that resulted in underpayment of royalties in connection with oil, natural gas and NGLs produced and sold. Devon is also involved in governmental agency proceedings and royalty audits and is subject to related contracts and regulatory controls in the ordinary course of business, some that may lead to additional royalty claims. Devon does not currently believe that it is subject to material exposure with respect to such royalty matters.</p></ix:nonNumeric>

<p style="text-align:center;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;color:#auto;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><span style="text-decoration:none;">NOTES TO CONSOLIDATED FINANCIAL STATEMENTS &#8211; (Continued)</span></p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;color:#auto;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><span style="text-decoration:none;">(Unaudited)</span><span style="text-decoration:underline;font-weight:normal;color:#000000;"> </span></p><ix:continuation id="F_000297_dcnt_750c946c-96e8-469b-affc-e3fcd3759fc1">
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-style:italic;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><span style="font-weight:bold;font-style:italic;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Environmental Matters</span></p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:12pt;text-indent:5.94%;color:#000000;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Devon is subject to certain laws and regulations relating to environmental remediation activities associated with past operations, such as the Comprehensive Environmental Response, Compensation, and Liability Act and similar state statutes. In response to liabilities associated with these activities, loss accruals primarily consist of estimated uninsured remediation costs. Devon&#8217;s monetary exposure for environmental matters is not expected to be material.</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:12pt;text-indent:5.94%;color:#000000;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Beginning in 2013, various parishes in Louisiana filed suit against more than&#160;<ix:nonFraction unitRef="U_dvnDefendant" id="F_000852" name="us-gaap:LossContingencyNumberOfDefendants" contextRef="C_0001090012_srtRangeAxis_srtMinimumMember_srtStatementGeographicalAxis_dvnParishesInLouisianaMember_20190101_20190331" decimals="INF">100</ix:nonFraction>&#160;oil and gas companies, including Devon, alleging that the companies&#8217; operations and activities in certain fields violated the State and Local Coastal Resource Management Act of 1978, as amended, and caused substantial environmental contamination, subsidence and other environmental damages to land and water bodies located in the coastal zone of Louisiana.&#160;The plaintiffs seek, among other things, the payment of the costs necessary to clear, re-vegetate and otherwise restore the allegedly impacted areas.&#160;Although Devon cannot predict the ultimate outcome of these matters, Devon is vigorously defending against these claims.</p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-style:italic;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Other Matters</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:6pt;text-indent:4.54%;color:#000000;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Devon is involved in other various legal proceedings incidental to its business. However, to Devon&#8217;s knowledge, there were no material pending legal proceedings to which Devon is a party or to which any of its property is subject.</p></ix:continuation><ix:nonNumeric id="F_000298" name="us-gaap:FairValueDisclosuresTextBlock" contextRef="C_0001090012_20190101_20190331" escape="true">

<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-style:italic;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Level 1 Fair Value Measurements</p>
<p style="margin-top:6pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-style:italic;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Cash equivalents<span style="font-style:normal;"> &#8211; Amounts consist primarily of money market investments and the fair value approximates the carrying value.</span></p>
<p style="margin-top:8pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-style:italic;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Level 2 Fair Value Measurements</p>
<p style="margin-top:6pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-style:italic;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Cash equivalents<span style="font-style:normal;"> &#8211; Amounts primarily consist of Canadian agency and provincial securities investments. The fair value approximates the carrying value.</span></p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;">&#160;</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-style:italic;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Commodity and interest rate derivatives<span style="font-style:normal;"> &#8211; The fair value of commodity derivatives is estimated using internal discounted cash flow calculations based upon forward curves and data obtained from independent third parties for contracts with similar terms or data obtained from counterparties to the agreements.</span></p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;">&#160;</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-style:italic;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Debt<span style="font-style:normal;"> &#8211; Devon&#8217;s debt instruments do not actively trade in an established market. The fair values of its debt are estimated based on rates available for debt with similar terms and maturity.</span></p></ix:nonNumeric>

<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:3.89%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Devon manages its operations through distinct operating segments, which are defined primarily by geographic areas. <p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;color:#000000;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><span style="Background-color:#FFFFFF;">&#160;</span></p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;color:#000000;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">In the fourth quarter of 2018, market forces widened Canadian heavy oil differentials beyond historical norms and negatively impacted the price we realized on our Canadian production. We had basis swaps for approximately half of our fourth quarter production to mitigate the effect of the lower market price. To further mitigate the effects of the lower price, we reduced our Jackfish production beginning in November 2018 which impacted our fourth quarter production by approximately 8 MBbls/d. Our Canadian heavy oil unhedged realized price for the fourth quarter of 2018 was near zero. During the first quarter of 2019, heavy oil differentials significantly improved primarily due to provincially mandated production cuts.</p>

<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a href="#TABLE_OF_CONTENTS"><span style="text-decoration:underline;">Table of Contents</span></a></p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-style:italic;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><span style="font-weight:bold;font-style:italic;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Results of Operations &#8211; </span><span style="font-weight:bold;font-style:italic;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Q1 2019</span><span style="font-weight:bold;font-style:italic;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"> vs. </span><span style="font-weight:bold;font-style:italic;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Q1 2018</span></p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;">&#160;</p>
<p style="margin-top:2pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">The following graphs, discussion and analysis are intended to provide an understanding of our results of operations and current financial condition. Specifically, the graph below shows the change in net earnings from the three months ended March 31, 2018 to the three months ended March 31, 2019. The material changes are further discussed by category on the following pages. To facilitate the review, these numbers are being presented before consideration of earnings attributable to noncontrolling interests. </p>
<p style="margin-top:2pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;">&#160;</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><img src="gvf2pujon0lp000004.jpg" title="" alt="" style="width:720px;height:291px;" /></p>
<p style="margin-top:2pt;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:4.03%;text-indent:0%;font-size:8pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">* Other includes asset dispositions, restructuring and transaction costs and other expenses.</p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;color:#000000;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Net earnings decreased $164 million during the first quarter of 2019 compared to the first quarter of 2018. The decrease primarily related to a $572 million decrease in upstream operations, driven by $668 million loss on valuation changes and cash settlements of commodity derivatives and a $60 million increase in depreciation, depletion and amortization. These changes were partially offset by lower financing costs primarily due to $312 million of early retirement of debt costs associated with our $800 million debt retirement in the first quarter of 2018<span style="color:#000000;">. </span></p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">The graph below presents the drivers of the upstream operations change presented above, with additional details and discussion of the drivers following the graph.</p>

<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-style:italic;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Operating Cash Flow</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;">&#160;</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">As presented in the table above, net cash provided by operating activities continued to be a significant source of capital and liquidity. However, changes in assets and liabilities, net, negatively impacted our operating cash flow by $302 million in the first quarter of 2019 primarily due to realizing impacts associated with the Canadian widening differentials in the fourth quarter of 2018. Excluding this short-term timing impact, operating cash flow before changes in assets and liabilities, net fully funded our capital expenditures during the first three months of 2019. We utilize available cash balances and divestiture proceeds to supplement our operating cash flows. </p>
